input.rationale: Section 3.4 gives Customer (not IBM) a convenience right over the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment on one month's notice, which is better than our fallback notice window, and IBM has no mid-term convenience right (its only mid-term exit under 3.3 is for material breach; its only other exit is 90 days' non-renewal notice under 3.2, which we address under RENEWAL). The single material gap is Section 3.4(b): the early termination charges are open-ended and cross-refer to Attachment A and Service Option Attachments (which IBM may change under 13.1), so the exit could carry an uncapped penalty and fails the fallback three-month fee cap. We therefore sit at the fallback save for that cap, and propose the shortest fix capping the charges at three months' charges. There is no pro-rata prepaid-fee refund, which we note but do not pursue at the fallback level.

proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges in Section 3.4(b).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our convenience exit is otherwise acceptable, but the early termination charges in Section 3.4(b) are open-ended; we have capped them at three months' charges, consistent with our fallback position on early-termination fees.
